title: growth-flip drift check spuriously FAILs a blessed growth demo that never spawns (no-junction or cap-before-first-window)
detail: A no-junction growth demo (explicitly allowed at parse) or one capped before tick 120 draws zero rng either way, so the flipped replay is byte-identical: ok=false and drift_check reports a false gate failure.
recommended_fix: Guard the growth_flip class on actual divergence capability: skip (or only warn) when the manifest shows zero growth spawns, e.g. compare live node counts or require >=1 spawn before asserting divergence.

title: growth_connectable ignores junction port capacity — a spawn can be unconnectable to every in-span router
detail: router_basic has port_capacity 4; growth spawns one terminal per 120 ticks around the mesh. A candidate whose only in-span junctions are port-full passes E31 but rejects the player's draw (Router_Ports_Full). Player can still place a new router, so no hard soft-lock.
recommended_fix: Extend growth_connectable (or the candidate acceptance) to require an in-span junction with a free port via ports_available, keeping it a read-only topology check.
